name: virtio-blk
summary: virtio-mmio transport and the block driver on top of it
why: The first driver to port, chosen because success is unarguable: bytes
come back off a QEMU disk or they do not. It needs no real hardware, it
is small, and it forces most of the shim that will ever exist -- printk,
kmalloc, ioremap, request_irq, spinlocks, wait queues, the device/driver
